source: IRS Publication 590-B, Table I (Single Life Expectancy) -- the post-2021 mortality table revision effective for distribution calendar years beginning 2022 (T.D. 9930), cross-checked against https://www.fidelity.com/bin-public/060_www_fidelity_com/documents/retirement/single-life-expectancy-table.pdf.
